sentence: Staff recommend approving a change that would raise the building from 31 to 45 storeys.
quote: This Report recommends approval of an application to amend Official Plan Amendment 731 and Site-Specific Zoning By-law 1166-2025 to permit an increase in height from 31 to 45 storeys

sentence: Council decided the changes it made were minor, so no further public notice was required.
